# TraceR

An app to create network-like representations.

## Notes for developers

When testing with a local docker container, please make sure to rebuild
the docker image after changes in the R code or dependencies. You can do
this from the root of the repository via:

``` bash
docker build -t tracer:latest .
```

After that, start the container as usual via:

``` bash
docker run -p 3838:3838 tracer:latest
```

and access the app in your browser at `http://localhost:3838/`. Stop the
container with `CTRL + C` in the terminal.

**Optional:**

Add `-it` for interactive mode, or `--rm` to remove the container after
stopping.

  : Create an example graph
- [`createGraphFromUpload()`](https://pandora-isomemo.github.io/TraceR/reference/createGraphFromUpload.md)
  : Creates a graph from a (uploaded) list
- [`displayNodeId()`](https://pandora-isomemo.github.io/TraceR/reference/displayNodeId.md)
  : Displays the node Id that was clicked
- [`downloadModuleServer()`](https://pandora-isomemo.github.io/TraceR/reference/downloadModuleServer.md)
  : Download JSON Module Server
- [`downloadModuleUI()`](https://pandora-isomemo.github.io/TraceR/reference/downloadModuleUI.md)
  : Download JSON Module UI
- [`importModuleServer()`](https://pandora-isomemo.github.io/TraceR/reference/importModuleServer.md)
  : Import JSON Module Server
- [`importModuleUI()`](https://pandora-isomemo.github.io/TraceR/reference/importModuleUI.md)
  : Import JSON Module UI
- [`initialize_graph_zooming()`](https://pandora-isomemo.github.io/TraceR/reference/initialize_graph_zooming.md)
  : Initialize panzoom
- [`renderFlowchart()`](https://pandora-isomemo.github.io/TraceR/reference/renderFlowchart.md)
  : Render flowchart
- [`startApplication()`](https://pandora-isomemo.github.io/TraceR/reference/startApplication.md)
  : Start Application
- [`updateGraph()`](https://pandora-isomemo.github.io/TraceR/reference/updateGraph.md)
  : Updates the reactive graph element with the uploaded graph
- [`updateInput()`](https://pandora-isomemo.github.io/TraceR/reference/updateInput.md)
